author: bardic-inspiration
name: Mantle of Many Winds
summary: A mantle that lets you fly and call forth gusts.
description: Wind-priests wore it and called it a tool. The hem is always stirring, even indoors.

stats.effect: While you wear this mantle, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet. As a Magic action, you can unleash a gust in a 30-foot cone: each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Strength saving throw or is pushed 20 feet away and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
